column1: # Hand-curated SIMBAD oid overrides — residual escape hatch.
# refresh:simbad-wds-xids finds a component's object by its `WDS J<id><comp>`
# ident, then by its letter on a sibling's HD / HIP or its CCDM id. A row here
# pins the object for a component neither reaches, and wins over both.
#   wds_id, component — a component the WDS summary decomposes into
#   simbad_oid        — SIMBAD basic.oid; the pull reads its main_id, Gaia
#                       DR3 source_id and HIP through it.
#   reason            — why, so the row can be audited; required.
